projects.title: RIVLD
projects.summary: React Native + Expo fitness app combining workout logging with competitive gym-territory gameplay—built end to end and submitted to the Apple App Store.
description: RIVLD is a React Native + Expo fitness tracking app that combines workout logging with competitive territory gameplay. Each gym is a territory where users compete for dominance through points earned from workouts.

Shipped end to end: Apple Sign In via Supabase Auth, profile onboarding, exercise logging (lifting, cardio, classes), auto-calculated points, interactive gym map, per-gym leaderboards, and achievements.
Backend on Supabase (PostgreSQL) with TanStack Query for client data management; submitted to the Apple App Store.
highlights: React Native + Expo iOS app submitted to the App Store
Apple Sign In, Supabase Auth, and PostgreSQL backend
Gym map, territory leaderboards, and workout point system
